Clean CARFAX. 1996 Chevrolet Blazer 4WD 4-Speed Automatic 4.3L V6 SMPI 12V 4WD.

This is such a uniquely preserved S-10 Blazer LS! A single-owner since 1999, this Blazer was meticulously cared for, garage kept, and kept out of the Pennsylvania winters which is why it's in such amazing shape today.

Being an LS it's equipped with full power options including the drivers seat. Everything looks to be in full working order - even the power mirrors. The air blows ICE COLD, all electronic functions work great, and the interior is basically spotless. Since it was garage kept the dash is in beautiful condition with no cracks which is rare for this generation GM vehicle.

All I can find wrong is the rear window wiper is very sluggish to move, it may need a new driver-motor at some point. And it looks like one of the oil cooler lines has very light seep which on 4.3L V6's was pretty normal, even when I was working on them 20+ years ago. The tires are in pretty good shape although they are older and should be replaced if the next owner plans to put a lot of miles on this.

We are firm on the price as the vehicle is. Excellent examples of these are bringing $15-20k in the market and it won't be easy to find a better example than this, especially in our area. This is most likely a cash purchase to please don't ask about financing as banks typically won't finance something like this.

2024 CHEVROLET SILVERADO 2500HD ZR2 BISON 4WD | 6.6L DURAMAX | AEV PACKAGE | TECHNOLOGY PACKAGE | POWER BOARDS | BLACK | LANCASTER PA

This 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD ZR2 Bison 4WD is powered by the 6.6L Duramax V8 turbodiesel paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission. Finished in Black, this is the top-level off-road HD setup with the ZR2 Bison Edition, AEV hardware, Technology Package, power running boards, and advanced trailering cameras.

The 6.6L Duramax produces 470 horsepower and 975 lb-ft of torque, giving the Bison serious towing and hauling capability along with massive low-end diesel torque. What makes this truck special, though, is that Chevrolet combines that HD capability with legitimate factory off-road hardware.

The ZR2 Suspension Package transforms the Silverado HD from a traditional heavy-duty pickup into a much more trail-capable truck. The Bison Edition takes it another step through Chevrolet's partnership with American Expedition Vehicles (AEV), adding heavy-duty AEV front and rear bumpers and exclusive 18-inch Carbon Flash Metallic wheels with AEV logos. It's one of the most distinctive factory HD trucks Chevrolet has built.

Inside, the Jet Black/Graystone perforated leather cabin gives you heated seating front and rear, a heated steering wheel, wireless charging, remote start, and the Multi-Flex Tailgate. Power up/down tailgate functionality makes bed access easier, while the power boards help with getting into this taller ZR2.

The Technology Package adds some of the truck's best equipment, including a massive 15-inch Head-Up Display and Rear Camera Mirror. You also get Adaptive Cruise Control, Bed View Camera, HD camera technology, and Trailer Camera Provisions.

It's well prepared for towing with an integrated trailering app, Hitch Guidance with Hitch View, Trailer Camera Provisions, and the Duramax drivetrain. The 120-volt outlets in both the cab and bed are useful for tools, chargers, or campsite equipment.

The bed is protected by a Chevytec spray-on bedliner and includes LED cargo lighting and the versatile Multi-Flex Tailgate.

Mileage makes this Bison even harder to duplicate. It's sitting 11,879 miles below the market average.

If you want an HD diesel that's different from the typical luxury-trim truck, the ZR2 Bison delivers: Duramax power, AEV hardware, ZR2 suspension, Technology Package, power boards, and extremely low mileage.

LED headlights, fog lamps, automatic high beams, and daytime running lights help improve visibility in changing conditions.

2001 Porsche Boxster S 60,060 Miles 6-Speed Manual Black/Black

Beautiful and well-cared-for 2001 Porsche Boxster S with just 60,060 miles. Finished in classic black over a black interior and equipped with the highly desirable 6-speed manual transmission.

I have owned this Porsche for many years and have enjoyed it primarily as a recreational car rather than daily transportation. The car comes with an extensive collection of maintenance and service records documenting its care over the years. Recent service at approximately 59,700 miles included replacement of a noisy right-front wheel bearing. It has also just received four brand-new tires and was professionally detailed in preparation for sale.

The 3.2-liter flat-six and mid-engine layout provide the balance, handling and connected driving experience that make the first-generation Boxster S such an enjoyable Porsche. Combined with the 6-speed manual transmission, this is a true driver's car.

Despite being a true mid-engine sports car, the Boxster is surprisingly practical, with both front and rear luggage compartments.

With only 60,060 miles, a 6-speed manual, classic black-on-black colors, excellent operating convertible top, extensive maintenance records and four new tires, this is an appealing example of the 986-generation Boxster S.

The car has two minor maintenance items that I will fully disclose to interested buyers. I believe in being straightforward about the car's condition and history.

I'm selling it simply because I'm not driving it enough anymore and would like to see it go to someone who will enjoy it.

Serious inquiries welcome. I'm happy to provide additional photographs and maintenance records and answer questions about the car

This 2023 Audi SQ8 4.0T Prestige quattro delivers commanding performance and luxury in a sophisticated gray exterior. Powered by a 4.0L V8 turbocharged engine producing 500 horsepower, this SUV combines athleticism with refined elegance. With approximately 38,275 miles on the odometer, it represents an excellent opportunity to own a premium German performance vehicle at a compelling value.

- Bang & Olufsen 3D Premium Sound System
- Head-Up Display
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Adaptive suspension with air suspension
- 22 5-V-Spoke star design wheels
- Heated and ventilated front seats with heated steering wheel
- Power soft-closing doors and power liftgate
- Remote Park Assist Plus with intersection assist
- Navigation system with MMI touch response
- Black Optic Package with high-gloss black exterior elements

This 2023 Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star delivers commanding presence and capability in a sharp gray exterior.
